feeds.title: Fletcher Russia and Eurasia Program Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the website of the Russia and Eurasia Program at The Fletcher School of Law and Diplomacy at Tufts University. The program includes the U.S.-Russia Relations Initiative. The initiative hosts an ongoing speaker series, awards an annual book prize, offers financial support for students, and supports student organizations such as the Fletcher Eurasia Club.

feeds.title: Window on Eurasia -- New Series
feeds.description: Paul Goble is a longtime specialist on ethnic and religious questions in Eurasia. Currently, in addition to preparing Windows on Eurasia, he writes for the Eurasia Daily Monitor of the Jamestown Foundation. Trained at Miami University and the University of Chicago, he has been decorated by the governments of Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania for his work in promoting Baltic independence.

feeds.title: Central Eurasian Studies Society
feeds.description: The mission of the Central Eurasian Studies Society is to: facilitate communication and interaction among scholars of the Central Eurasia region, and in doing so to promote high standards of scholarship and instruction about the Central Eurasia region; to promote cooperation among persons and organizations concerned with the scholarly study of Central Eurasia; and to promote general knowledge of and public interest in Central Eurasia.

feeds.title: University of Helsinki Blog
feeds.description: Our site brings together the diverse research projects conducted or coordinated by the Aleksanteri Institute, University of Helsinki, that focus on the ways in which various global processes and flows emerge in the Eurasian context. In geographic terms, our research and activities focus on the post-socialist space where we examine globalized societal transformation through such topics as governance, migration, religion, and informality.

feeds.title: Eurasia Review
feeds.description: Eurasia Review is an independent Journal that provides a venue for analysts and experts to disseminate content on a wide range of subjects that are often overlooked or under-represented by Western-dominated media. It believes a greater understanding of cultural differences is the path toward a safer, more secure, and just world.

feeds.title: Mission Eurasia
feeds.description: Mission Eurasia trains, equips, and mobilizes national Christian leaders throughout Eurasia and Israel who are engaging in evangelism, church planting, holistic ministries, and church growth to transform their countries for Christ. It focuses the gifts and energies of the global church on training and mobilizing young national Christian leaders in the countries of Eurasia and Israel.
